WebP Converter

Convert JPG, PNG and other images to the modern WebP format for much smaller file sizes at the same visual quality. Batch convert and download as a ZIP.

    WebP is supported in all modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 14+) and keeps transparency like PNG. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

    📖 How to use

    1. Drop one or more images (JPG, PNG, …) into the upload zone.
    2. Set the WebP quality slider (10–100).
    3. Click “Convert to WebP” and compare original vs WebP sizes.
    4. Download each .webp file individually or all together as a ZIP.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Why use WebP instead of JPG?

    WebP is typically 25–35% smaller than JPG at the same visual quality, and unlike JPG it supports transparency. All modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 14+) display WebP.

    Does WebP keep transparency?

    Yes — WebP supports alpha transparency just like PNG, so transparent areas stay transparent.

    Are my images uploaded?

    No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded and there are no limits.
